title: b7z9.37(c): root_seq cache keyed (dodag_id, instance) in DODAG state
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37 (spec/06-security.md:668: Cache root_seq keyed by (dodag_id, instance); L687 MUST NOT wrap). The Python oracle's cached_seq parameter has zero production callers. Implement the anti-replay root_seq cache in DODAG state — decide and document which language lands it first (suggest Rust lichen-node DODAG state consumed by the sibling receiver-validation child (a)); wrap attempt fails closed and is auditable. Test replay-of-equal-or-lower-seq rejection and per-(dodag_id,instance) isolation.
